name: Jasmine
epithet: Leader of the Rain of Palma
personality: Seasoned, pragmatic mercenary captain driven by memories and money.
story: Jasmine, 38, is a Brigid mercenary who served an Aragonian noble house until it collapsed. She now leads the mercenary company the Rain of Palma, motivated by her late spouse, her comrades and pay. She is available in Dagsion from around 5/8 and costs only 500G on Leda's route.

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A tier. KeenGamer: B tier (counter fighter, cheap on Leda's route).

recruit.tip: 2,000G here; Leda's 500G was cheaper but her roster was full.

guide.summary: Benched in Part I: she joins in Ch 10 at about Lv 25, already in a Specialty class, with no deployment slot left to reach Lv 35 before Part II. Expert Counter (Hit +20 when attacked first) plus Great Counter and Focused Counter make her an enemy-phase wall from Part II Ch 2, and Dreadnought grows Def 75, HP 65 on her.
guide.playstyle: Plant her on chokepoints where only physical units reach her. Mov 4 and Res 15%: Ninae or Ultand stand beside her against mages.
keys: Bench in Part I: Arena Heavy Training covers Heavy D, Axe B, Spear B and Authority C.
Equip Ji, the Ch 10 Hammer, Shielding Axe, Da Mina Spear and the Hexlock Shield at the end of Ch 12.
Joins as a Specialty unit (Armored Knight?): master Great Counter on the bench; Dreadnought in Part II Ch 2 (Ch 3 at the latest).
watch: Mov 4: she lags behind the mounted army.
Res growth 15% in Dreadnought: mages and Caladrius foes delete her.

Heavy kit is fine: she counters on enemy phase and won't double anyway. Silver Spear 6 (Ji 7) + Hexlock Shield 4 + Victory Gem 3 + Charm Mask 5 = 18 to 19 is the everyday load (Part III: Silver Shield 4 + Cloth of Aurora 5 = 20 to 21); Hammer 20 swaps in for armor only.
Inventory: 6/6 armor kit (Silver Spear, Shielding Axe, Hexlock Shield, Victory Gem, Charm Mask, Elixir): no open slot, so the Hammer and Ji wait in storage.
